title: Yoisaki Kanade — Loved By Music〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to refine this bass line a bit more...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's still light out. I'll finish it before everyone comes on.)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Most of the high schools in this area are having exams now, so I think Amia may come on earlier, too.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Okay. That's must be why she said she would be coming in the afternoon today.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yes. She helps to clean the house and do other housework. Is that strange?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<It's not strange... More like unusual?
It's not every day you hear of someone with a part-time housekeeper.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Well. I didn't think you were the sort to allow strangers into your house.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <But you don't want people touching your equipment, right?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <She checked with me on the first day what are the things she could touch and what to stay away from.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Wow, that's really professional of her.
What sort of person is she?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Apparently so.
I heard they're usually housewives.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <She's a part-timer who just so happened to sign up for the job, but she's really good at her work.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <By the way, Yuki, how's your progress with the lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <I just hope they match the image of the melody line that you gave me.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Haha. That puts a lot of pressure on me!>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Just keep doing what you've been doing. Enanan's pictures, Amia's videos, and your lyrics... They're never too far off from the image of the song.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Hey, did you approach us because you thought we would just go along with the things you had in mind?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<No.
It's because I felt like we all seemed alike somehow.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Yuki, show me what you've already written for the lyrics.>
